description: This file defines a composable UI component named TalkOrbOverlay for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It creates a visual overlay with animated concentric rings and status indicators for speaking, listening, or thinking states, possibly in a voice interaction context.

methods.name: TalkOrbOverlay
methods.description: A Jetpack Compose @Composable function that displays an animated overlay with concentric rings and a status message indicating listening, speaking, or thinking state.
